title: F14 · CI workflow: typecheck + vitest on PR
goal: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm test` on pull requests and pushes to main/feature branches, so regressions are caught before merge. No deploy, no auto-merge. Suggestion-only.

acceptanceCriteria.text: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs on pull_request + push to main
Job installs with npm ci, runs typecheck, runs vitest
